link.note: Ruled out in round 3: Servatius's wife was Agatha Heizler b. 26 Jun 1813 Munzingen. This woman's 1855 marriage records no earlier husband.

summary: The competing 'Maria Anna Heitzler 1813' of Unteribental — NOT John's 4th great-grandmother.
bio: Schoolteacher's daughter; married the widower J. G. Gremmelspacher at Kirchzarten 23 Oct 1855 (he remarried 1863, so she died before 1863). The deep-dive had proposed she was Servatius's widow; disproven.
